findings.claim: The wiki and changeset define a bot with three arms and say the verb prints one row per bot-rooted thread with nothing skipped silently, while the root test is only core's exact four-name list, so an App-rooted thread prints no row.
findings.counterexample: A thread rooted by {__typename:'Bot', login:'github-actions'} yields no row at all, though the wiki's own bot definition covers it. Safety-neutral: merge-ready's predicate 2 denies on the same narrow list. Folded: both texts state that rows are printed for threads rooted by core's review-bot identities and that the three-arm test decides who counts as a human reply.

findings.claim: The fold commit's narration said both review-reply ordering locks could pass vacuously; only the disposition-step lock could, because the dry/apply needles are strict substrings of the toContain fences that run first.
findings.counterexample: Mutant A (dry-run fence deleted) fails at the toContain line before the ordering lock; mutant B (disposition step reworded) passes every pre-fold assertion and fails only the post-fold presence guard. Fix correct, narration overstated. Folded: a test comment names the one needle that lacked a presence lock.

findings.claim: KNOWN_BOT_LOGINS keeps fixture defaults honest so a test never models a review bot as a User.
findings.counterexample: It listed github-actions (not one of core's identities) and omitted github-code-quality (one of core's four), so a ghcq fixture defaulted to User — the miss the comment claimed to prevent; no behavioural effect (the exact-list arm catches ghcq). Only two of four entries had been verified live. Folded: the list derives from core's BOT_REVIEWER_IDENTITIES with github-actions kept as a separate App constant.

findings.claim: Both --json document shapes are locked by a test.
findings.counterexample: The failure arms assert the exact key set; the success test spot-checked five fields, leaving seven of summary's eight fields and any added key unasserted. Folded: the success document's key set and every summary field asserted exactly.

verdict: termination named on the second of two legs: the first leg's 11 findings (two MATERIAL — the never-writes spy rebuilt as an allowlist, App replies no longer human evidence — and nine MINOR; ten folded) verified as genuinely fixed under adversarial probing, live GitHub reads and an injected-write mutant; this leg adds four MINOR precision items (two doc/narration, one fixture-comment accuracy, one success-JSON assertion strength), all folded, none rewiring semantics
